content.comment_body: Hello, thank you for the update. Do you have any information on when it will become available?
No, not at this time. The [product_name] can be ordered from the [company_name] online store, but there is no specified delivery date.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is inquiring about the availability of the [product_name] and requests details about its stock status. Another user responds that the product can be ordered from the [company_name] store, but no delivery information has been provided. The primary issue is the absence of clear and timely information regarding availability and delivery, which leads to uncertainty for users trying to plan purchases.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want prompt and clear updates on when products will be in stock and expect to receive estimated delivery timelines to assist with planning.
